snippet: THE BLOCK: Layer 1 blockchain Fogo halted its mainnet and said it would restrict addresses after an attacker received 400 million FOGO tokens, about 10% of circulating supply. The halt came roughly 15 hours after the Fogo Foundation said the $3 million compromise had not affected chain operations.
